mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_content, d.academic_year, d.semester_code::integer AS semester, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref
FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_element_management_item_settings WHERE management_item_code = #{code} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND area_code = 'EDUCATION'
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{code}, achievement_date = #{date}, attachment_ref = #{attachments}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N'
